name: Unidentified criminal group's starship
description: A starship was utilized by a criminal group in 3 ABY. The starship was in space above when Luke Skywalker flew his T-65B X-wing starfighter near the ship. The group's boss wanted a T-65 and the captain ordered the starship to use it's magna-harpoons to fire at the ship. As the ship started to bring in Skywalker, Darth Vader used his TIE Advanced to free Skywalker for himself and fired at the ship.
